title: WALK THE TALK? MEASURING THE FAITHFULNESS OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL EXPLANATIONS
reasoning: The paper introduces a technical measurement methodology for 'faithfulness' in Large Language Model (LLM) explanations, focused on the consistency between a model's stated reasoning and its actual decision-making process. While it uses social bias tasks (race and gender) as a primary case study for identifying unfaithful explanations, the research aims to quantify technical faithfulness in explainable AI (XAI) rather than benchmarking or evaluating the model's adherence to moral, religious, or ethical belief systems.
